content: Yenibɑn biru, ye yɑ koorɑ wee. Abusɑlɔmu, Dɑfidin bii, u sesu mɔ wi bɑ sokumɔ Tɑmɑɑ. Kurɔ burɔn tiiwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ. Yerɑ ben tundo turosi wi bɑ mɔ̀ Amɔɔ u nùn kĩɑ too,
sere kĩi te, tɑ derɑ u ǹ mɑɑ yɛ̃ ye u mɔ̀. Mɑ u tii kuɑ bɑrɔ. Adɑmɑ Tɑmɑɑ u ǹ ɡinɑ durɔ yɛ̃, yɑ mɑɑ sɛ̃ Amɔɔ u kɑ nùn kpunɑ.
N deemɑ Amɔɔ u bɔrɔ ɡoo mɔ wi bɑ sokumɔ Yonɑdɑbu. U sɑ̃ɑwɑ Dɑfidin mɔɔ Sɑmɑn bii. U mɑɑ bwisi mɔ too.
Mɑ u Amɔɔ bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ woorɑmɔ ɑ dɔɔ, wunɛ wi ɑ sɑ̃ɑ sinɑ bokon bii. A mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɔ ye n nun mɔ̀. Mɑ Amɔɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn sesu Tɑmɑɑwɑ nɑ kĩ, Abusɑlɔmun mɛro turosi.

Mɑ Yonɑdɑbu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ kpunɑ kpɑ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑ bɑrɔwɑ. Wunɛn tundo, ù n nɑ wunɛn mi, kpɑ ɑ nùn sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, u de wunɛn sesu Tɑmɑɑ u nɑ wunɛn mi, u nun dĩɑnu kuɑ ɑ n wɑɑmɔ, kpɑ ɑ nu mwɑ win nɔmɑn di ɑ sere di.

Mɑ Amɔɔ u dɑ u kpunɑ u tii bɑrɑru mɑni. Yerɑ sinɑ boko Dɑfidi u nùn berɑm nɑ. Mɑ Amɔɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ, ɑ de nɛn sesu Tɑmɑɑ u nɑ u mɑn kirɑnu yiru kuɑ nɑ n wɑɑmɔ, kpɑ n nu mwɑ win nɔmɑn di n di.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u sɔmɔ ɡɔrɑ Tɑmɑɑn mi, u nùn sɔ̃ u nɛɛ, u doo u win sesu Amɔɔ deemɑ win dirɔ u nùn dĩɑnu kuɑ.
Yerɑ Tɑmɑɑ u dɑ u Amɔɔ deemɑ diru mi u kpĩ, mɑ u som suɑ u burɑ u kirɑ ni kuɑ Amɔɔn nɔni biru.
Yen biru u kirɑ weke te suɑ mɑ u kirɑ ni ɡɔsie ɡbɛ̃ɛru ɡɑru sɔɔ. Adɑmɑ Amɔɔ u yinɑ u di. U nɛɛ, bu tɔmbu kpuro yɑro win dirun di. Yerɑ be kpuro bɑ yɑrɑ min di.
Sɑɑ yerɑ Amɔɔ u Tɑmɑɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kɑ kirɑ ni nɑ dii sɔɔwɔ kpɑ n nu mwɑ wunɛn nɔmun di, n sere di. Mɑ Tɑmɑɑ u kirɑ ni suɑ u kɑ nùn dɑɑwɑ dii sɔɔ mi.
Ye u nùn kirɑ ni wɛ̃ɛmɔ, yerɑ Amɔɔ u nùn ɡɑbɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ de n kɑ nun kpunɑ, nɛn sesu.
Mɑ Tɑmɑɑ u nɛɛ, ɑɑwo, ɑ ku mɑn sɑnku. Domi bɑ ku rɑ yen bweseru ko bɛsɛ Isirelibɑ sɔɔ. A ku bɛɛrɛ sɑri kom mɛ ko.
À n kuɑ mɛ, mɑnɑ kon we kɑ seku ten bweseru. Mɛyɑ wunɛn tii kɑɑ ko bɛɛrɛ sɑri bɛsɛ Isirelibɑ sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ bɛsɛn tundo sinɑ boko sɔ̃ɔwɔ. U ǹ yinɑmɔ ɑ mɑn suɑ kurɔ.
Adɑmɑ Amɔɔ kun Tɑmɑɑn ɡɑri yi wure. Mɑ u nùn tilɑsi kuɑ u kɑ nùn kpunɑ.
Yen biru Amɔɔ u nùn tusɑ too n kere kĩi te u rɑɑ nùn kĩ. Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ seewo ɑ doonɑ.
Yerɑ Tɑmɑɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ku mɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ sosi kɔ̃sɑ ye ɑ mɑn kuɑ sɔɔ ɑ n mɑn ɡire. Adɑmɑ Amɔɔ u ǹ win ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑki.
Mɑ u ɑluwɑɑsi wi u nùn nɔɔrimɔ sokɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ kurɔ wini ɡiro minin di. A de u yɑri tɔɔwɔ kpɑ ɑ ɡɑmbo kɛnɛ ɑ bɛri.
Mɑ Amɔɔn ɑluwɑɑsi wi, u Tɑmɑɑ yɑrɑ u ɡɑmbo ye kɛnuɑ. N deemɑ yɑbe nɔniɡirɑ
Tɑmɑɑ u sebuɑ. Ten bweserɑ sinɑ bokon bii wɔndiɑ be bɑ ǹ durɔ yɛ̃ bɑ rɑ sebe.
Ye Tɑmɑɑ u yɑrɑ, yerɑ u tii torom wisi wirɔ mɑ u win yɑbe nɔniɡii te ɡĩɑ u kɑ win nuku sɑnkirɑnu sɔ̃ɔsi. U wiru nɔmɑ sɔndi u sumɔ kɑ dɑm.

Yerɑ win sesu Abusɑlɔmu u nɑ u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, Amɔɔ u kɑ nun kpunɑ? Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ seewo, nɛn sesu, ɑ ku ɡɑri yi ɡɑrisi ɡɔ̃ruɔ too, domi wunɛn sesuwɑ. Adɑmɑ kɑ mɛ, Tɑmɑɑn nukurɑ sɑnkirɑ too. Mɑ u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ Abusɑlɔmun dirɔ.
Sinɑ boko Dɑfidi u ye kpuro nuɑ, yerɑ u mɔru kuɑ. Adɑmɑ u ǹ Amɔɔ ɡerusi, yèn sɔ̃ u sɑ̃ɑ win bii ɡbiikoo mɑ u nùn kĩ too.
Abusɑlɔmu kun mɑɑ Amɔɔ ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Adɑmɑ u nùn tusɑ yèn sɔ̃ u win sesu tilɑsi kuɑ u kɑ kpunɑ.
Abusɑlɔmu u win sesu
mɔru bɑrɑ
Wɔ̃ɔ yirun biru, sɔ̃ɔ teeru Abusɑlɔmu u win yɑ̃ɑnun sɑnsu bɔɔrimɔ Bɑɑli Hɑsoriɔ Efɑrɑimun tem bɔkuɔ. Mɑ u win tundo turosibu sinɑ bokon bibu kpuro dim sokɑ.
U sere bu dim mɛ soku, u dɑ u sinɑ boko deemɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, wee bɑ nɛn yɑ̃ɑnun sɑnsu bɔɔrimɔ, sɑ yen tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru mɔ̀. Nɑ kĩ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu i nɑ i kɑ sun di.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑɑwo, nɛn bii, bɛsɛn kpuro kun dɔɔ. Domi sɔmunu koo kpɛ̃ɑ. Mɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ suuru ko, ɑ de ɑ dɑ kɑ mɛ. Adɑmɑ sinɑ boko u yinɑ. Domɑrɑ u nùn kuɑ.
Yerɑ u sinɑ boko sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ de bɑɑ nɛn mɔɔ Amɔɔ u nɑ. Mɑ sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ kĩ u nɑ wunɛn mi.
Abusɑlɔmu u mɑɑ sinɑ boko suuru kɑnɑ, mɑ u derɑ Amɔɔ u dɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ win bii be bɑ tie kpuro.

Yerɑ Abusɑlɔmu u win sɔm kowobu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i n lɑɑkɑri sɑ̃ɑ sɑnɑm mɛ tɑm mu koo Amɔɔ ɡo. Sɑɑ yerɑ kon bɛɛ sɔ̃ n nɛɛ, i nùn soowo i ɡo. I ku bɛrum ko domi nɛnɑ nɑ bɛɛ woodɑ wɛ̃ɛmɔ. I de i yɔ̃rɑ i tɔn durɔ kom sɔ̃ɔsi.
Mɑ Abusɑlɔmun sɔm kowo be, bɑ Amɔɔ kuɑ nɡe mɛ u ɡeruɑ. Yerɑ sinɑ bokon bii be bɑ tie ben bɑɑwure u win kɛtɛku yɔɔwɑ u dukɑ suɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ duki yɑrinɑ mi, yerɑ Dɑfidi u nuɑ mɑ bɑ win bibu kpuro ɡo, bɑɑ ben turo kun tie.
Mɑ u seewɑ u win yɑberu nɛnuɑ u kɑrɑnɑ u kpunɑ temɔ nuku sɑnkirɑnun sɔ̃. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ kuɑ.
Yonɑdɑbu, Dɑfidin mɔɔ Sɑmɑn bii, u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, ɑ ku nɛɛ, bɑ wunɛn bibu kpuro ɡo. Domi Amɔɔ tɔnɑwɑ u ɡu. Sɑɑ dɔmɑ tèn di u kɑ Tɑmɑɑ kpunɑ kɑ dɑm mi, yerɑ Abusɑlɔmu u kɑ bwisikɑ u nùn ɡo.
Yen sɔ̃ tɛ̃, ɑ ku ɡɔ̃ru doke mɑ wunɛn bibu kpurowɑ bɑ ɡu. Adɑmɑ ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ Amɔɔ tɔnɑwɑ u ɡu.
Yen biru Abusɑlɔmu u dukɑ yɑkurɑ. Gbɑ̃rɑrun kɔnnɔ kɔ̃so u sĩirɑ u wɑ wee, tɔn wɔru ɡɑ wee win biruɔ ɡuurun berɑ ɡiɑn di. Mɑ u dɑ u sinɑ boko sɔ̃ɔwɑ ye u wɑ.
Mɑ Yonɑdɑbu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, wunɛn bibɑ. Wee bɑ wee. N ǹ mɛyɑ nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔwɑ?
Sere u kɑ ɡɑri yi ɡere u kpe, yerɑ sinɑ bokon bii be, bɑ tunumɑ. Mɑ bɑ wuri wɔri. Sinɑ bokon tii kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ mɑɑ swĩ ɡem ɡem.

N deemɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Abusɑlɔmu u kpikiru woo Tɑlimɑi, Amihudun biin mi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ Gesurin sinɑ boko. Mɑ u sinɑ mi, n kɑ kuɑ wɔ̃ɔ itɑ. Sɑɑ ye kpuro sɔɔ, Dɑfidi u wɑ̃ɑ win sinɑ kpɑɑrɔ u win bii Amɔɔn ɡɔɔ sumɔ.
Sɑɑ ye Dɑfidin nukurɑ yɛmiɑ, win mɔru ye u kɑ Abusɑlɔmu mɔ̀ yɑ sure.
Yoɑbu u kĩ
Abusɑlɔmu u ɡɔsirɑmɑ yɛnuɔ
